    # Copy the large filled silhouette by translating it to replace each hollow matching silhouette.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v})
    comps=[]
    for c in colors:
        seen=set()
        for r in range(h):
            for col in range(w):
                if grid[r][col]!=c or (r,col) in seen: continue
                stack=[(r,col)]; seen.add((r,col)); pts=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for p in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                        if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==c:
                            seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
                comps.append((c,pts))
    # Identify each component as a raster shape; find same-color copies where one has strictly more cells.
    shapes=[]
    for c,pts in comps:
        minr=min(y for y,x in pts); minc=min(x for y,x in pts)
        mask=frozenset((y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in pts)
        maxr=max(y for y,x in pts)-minr+1; maxc=max(x for y,x in pts)-minc+1
        shapes.append((c,pts,mask,maxr,maxc))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i,(c,pts,mask,mr,mc) in enumerate(shapes):

                for y,x in mask2-mask:
                    out[y0+y][x0+x]=c
